description: 12h memory-stability soak - Python valkey-glide-python, one cell. There is no bench-aws.sh version flag for this client: bump valkey-glide in python/pyproject.toml on a pushed ref and pass --repo-tag. Memory signal: engine process-group RSS sampled every 5s into <label>.system.ndjson. 64 connections = 64 worker coroutines on one asyncio loop; under the ~128 in-flight ceiling in python/README.md, so the loop is not the bottleneck on an 8-vCPU m5.2xlarge. Launch with --runtime-cap 780 so the cap never fires before the upload; run soakctl-python on its own instance in parallel as the control.
